records.name: Gide melanoma immunotherapy
records.subtitle: PRJEB23709 · Single-agent and combination checkpoint blockade
records.accessDetail: Public sequencing records in ENA/SRA; use the linked paper for clinical annotations and treatment groups.
records.summary: Tumour RNA profiles from melanoma patients receiving single-agent or combined checkpoint inhibitors.
records.usefulFor: Compare response-associated expression across the two treatment strategies.
records.caveat: Sequence records are not the full published biopsy cohort; match sample IDs and clinical annotations before comparison.
records.sourceNote: BioProject and the original paper identify the treatment groups, response analyses and sequencing accession.

records.name: Riaz nivolumab cohort
records.subtitle: GSE91061 · Before and during treatment
records.accessDetail: Processed expression matrices are listed on GEO; the record also links public raw reads in SRA.
records.summary: Longitudinal melanoma tumour expression profiles collected before and during nivolumab.
records.usefulFor: Study how the tumour microenvironment changes alongside treatment response.
records.caveat: Repeated biopsies are not independent patients; prior ipilimumab exposure varies.
records.sourceNote: GEO lists pretreatment and on-treatment RNA samples; the publication confirms nivolumab and response analyses.

records.name: Hugo anti-PD-1 cohort
records.subtitle: GSE78220 · Pretreatment melanoma biopsies
records.accessDetail: The GEO series provides an expression spreadsheet and links raw reads in SRA; clinical context is in the original paper.
records.summary: Pretreatment melanoma expression data linked to response to PD-1 blockade.
records.usefulFor: Examine baseline expression patterns associated with resistance.
records.caveat: This GEO entry is the transcriptomic subset; it is not the complete genomic cohort described in the paper.
records.sourceNote: GEO identifies pretreatment biopsies and response comparisons; the paper also reports survival analyses.

records.name: Sade-Feldman immune-cell atlas
records.subtitle: GSE120575 · Checkpoint-treated melanoma
records.accessDetail: Processed expression and patient-ID files are public on GEO. Raw sequencing is in controlled-access dbGaP, phs001680.v1.p1.
records.summary: Single-cell profiles of tumour-infiltrating immune cells from checkpoint-treated melanoma.
records.usefulFor: Explore immune-cell states associated with response or resistance.
records.caveat: CD45-positive immune cells were selected; this is not an unbiased atlas of every tumour cell type.
records.sourceNote: GEO states CD45-positive sorting and separates processed files from raw dbGaP data.

records.name: Kim lung immunotherapy cohort
records.subtitle: GSE135222 · Advanced non-small-cell lung cancer
records.accessDetail: Processed RNA expression is public on GEO, with raw-read links in SRA.
records.summary: RNA profiles from advanced lung cancers treated with PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitors.
records.usefulFor: Investigate expression patterns in an immunotherapy-treated lung cohort.
records.caveat: The RNA series is a subset of the wider methylation study; do not use its sample count for all assays.
records.sourceNote: The official GEO record identifies the cancer, treatment classes and downloadable expression table.

records.name: Cho lung response cohort
records.subtitle: GSE126044 · Responders and non-responders
records.accessDetail: RNA count data are listed on GEO, with raw reads in SRA; the related methylation series is linked separately.
records.summary: Lung tumour transcriptomes comparing response groups during anti-PD-1 treatment.
records.usefulFor: Explore response-associated expression with explicit responder labels.
records.caveat: Fresh and FFPE material are both represented; account for specimen handling.
records.sourceNote: GEO and BioProject describe response-group comparison and mixed specimen preparation.

records.name: IMvigor210 molecular cohort
records.subtitle: EGAS00001002556 · Atezolizumab in urothelial cancer
records.accessDetail: Request the RNA and exome datasets from their EGA data-access committee. Historical processed packages exist, but this entry points to the controlled archive.
records.summary: Pretreatment bladder tumour RNA and exome profiles associated with atezolizumab response.
records.usefulFor: Investigate immune exclusion and molecular correlates of PD-L1 blockade.
records.caveat: Exome and RNA coverage differ; access approval and permitted use must be checked for the chosen dataset.
records.sourceNote: The EGA study lists the RNA and exome datasets and identifies atezolizumab-treated metastatic urothelial cancer.

records.name: SU2C–MARK lung cohort
records.subtitle: phs002822.v1.p1 · Checkpoint blockade response
records.accessDetail: The dbGaP sequencing and phenotype datasets require an authorised-access application; permissions vary by contributing cohort.
records.summary: Lung tumour exomes, selected RNA profiles and matched response data from immunotherapy-treated patients.
records.usefulFor: Connect tumour genomics with observed checkpoint-blockade response.
records.caveat: RNA is available only for a subset, and the archive does not contain every patient in the published analysis.
records.sourceNote: dbGaP confirms matched response data and assay coverage; the paper describes deposition exclusions.

records.name: Breast chemotherapy response
records.subtitle: GSE25066 · Discovery and validation cohorts
records.accessDetail: GEO provides array files, series matrices and links to the discovery and validation subseries.
records.summary: Bulk tumour expression linked to neoadjuvant chemotherapy response and subsequent survival.
records.usefulFor: Explore baseline expression against response and follow-up in separate study subsets.
records.caveat: Expression was measured by microarray, not RNA sequencing; preserve discovery and validation separation.
records.sourceNote: The GEO SuperSeries names the treatment, response and survival endpoints and links both component cohorts.

records.name: Wu breast cell atlas
records.subtitle: GSE176078 · Tumour cell types and tissue organisation
records.accessDetail: Processed single-cell and bulk expression files are public on GEO. Raw human sequencing is controlled in EGA; consult the paper for spatial data locations.
records.summary: Breast tumour single-cell and matched bulk expression in a study of spatial cell organisation.
records.usefulFor: Explore malignant, immune and stromal populations across breast cancer subtypes.
records.caveat: The GEO accession is not a complete spatial-data download; follow the study links for that layer.
records.sourceNote: The record describes the single-cell/spatial study, matched bulk RNA and raw-data EGA restriction.

records.name: Lee colorectal cell atlas
records.subtitle: GSE132465 · Tumour and matched normal mucosa
records.accessDetail: Processed expression matrices and cell annotations are public on GEO. Raw sequencing was not deposited because of patient privacy.
records.summary: Single-cell expression profiles from colorectal tumours and matched normal tissue.
records.usefulFor: Explore cancer cells, surrounding cell types and potential cellular interactions.
records.caveat: This is a tissue atlas, not a treatment-response cohort; raw sequencing is unavailable in the record.
records.sourceNote: GEO lists processed count matrices, cell annotations and the explicit raw-data limitation.

records.name: METABRIC breast cohort
records.subtitle: Genome and transcriptome with long-term follow-up
records.accessDetail: Processed study data can be explored in cBioPortal. Original expression and copy-number files are listed in EGA with committee-controlled access.
records.summary: Breast tumour expression and copy-number data with long-term clinical follow-up.
records.usefulFor: Study molecular subgroups and prognostic associations in breast cancer.
records.caveat: Retrospective cohort and multiple data releases; check patient overlap and follow-up definitions.
records.sourceNote: EGA describes paired genome/transcriptome analysis and follow-up; cBioPortal indexes the processed METABRIC study.

records.name: GENIE BioPharma Collaborative
records.subtitle: Public cohorts with detailed clinical annotation
records.accessDetail: Public releases require a Synapse account and acceptance of data-use terms. Consortium-only releases are separate and are not included here.
records.summary: Clinico-genomic cohorts linking tumour sequencing to longitudinal treatment and outcome records.
records.usefulFor: Find patient cohorts for real-world treatment and outcome research.
records.caveat: Available variables and releases differ by cancer; delayed cohort entry and selection can bias outcome analyses.
records.sourceNote: AACR lists public BPC cohorts; the project guide explains account access, release selection and analytic bias.

records.name: The Cancer Genome Atlas
records.subtitle: TCGA · Molecular profiles across cancer types
records.accessDetail: Many processed molecular and clinical files are open in GDC. Identifiable sequence and selected clinical files require dbGaP authorisation.
records.summary: A multi-cancer collection of molecular profiles, tissue information and clinical follow-up.
records.usefulFor: Find reference cohorts for tumour biology and prognostic analyses.
records.caveat: Not a dedicated drug-combination response dataset; treatment and outcome completeness differ between projects.
records.sourceNote: NCI documents the assays and clinical data; GDC explains file-level access tiers.

records.name: CPTAC proteogenomics
records.subtitle: Protein measurements alongside tumour genomics
records.accessDetail: Proteomic data are open in PDC. GDC provides processed molecular data, while protected sequencing requires dbGaP approval.
records.summary: Cancer cohorts connecting protein measurements with DNA and RNA characterisation.
records.usefulFor: Find multi-omic material for studying pathways beyond RNA abundance.
records.caveat: Assays and clinical annotations vary by study; matched layers are not available for every specimen.
records.sourceNote: NCI lists the available tumour types, molecular layers and open/controlled access split.

records.name: Human Tumor Atlas Network
records.subtitle: HTAN · Single-cell, spatial and imaging collections
records.accessDetail: Clinical metadata, many processed assays and images are open; some downloads need a free repository account. Raw genomic files require controlled access.
records.summary: Tumour atlases linking cell states, tissue organisation and clinical context across studies.
records.usefulFor: Find single-cell and spatial material for tumour-microenvironment research.
records.caveat: Atlas designs and assay coverage differ; a collection listing does not guarantee treatment outcomes.
records.sourceNote: HTAN documentation distinguishes public metadata/processed layers from controlled raw sequencing.

records.name: TISCH2
records.subtitle: Tumour immune single-cell hub
records.accessDetail: Processed expression, annotations and analysis outputs can be downloaded by dataset; original raw-data access depends on the contributing study.
records.summary: A curated collection of human and mouse tumour single-cell expression studies.
records.usefulFor: Locate cell-type expression and immune-microenvironment datasets by cancer and treatment.
records.caveat: Contains human and mouse studies and overlaps individual GEO cohorts; filter species and avoid duplicate cohorts.
records.sourceNote: The resource documentation and original paper describe species, treatment categories and processed-data downloads.

records.name: NCI ALMANAC
records.subtitle: Pairwise anticancer-drug combination screen
records.accessDetail: NCI provides downloadable combination-screen data and CellMiner ComboScore tables.
records.summary: Drug-pair growth-inhibition measurements across the NCI-60 cancer cell-line panel.
records.usefulFor: Find experimentally tested combinations and their cell-line response patterns.
records.caveat: Cell-line growth inhibition and ComboScores are not evidence of patient benefit.
records.sourceNote: NCI and the original study describe pairwise experiments, downloadable results and ComboScores.

records.name: DrugComb
records.subtitle: Aggregated combination and single-agent screens
records.accessDetail: The University of Helsinki links open summary datasets and dose-level files through Zenodo.
records.summary: A harmonised collection of published drug-combination and monotherapy screening results.
records.usefulFor: Find drug pairs and compare recorded activity across contributing screens.
records.caveat: Contributing studies use different assays and can overlap resources such as NCI ALMANAC; retain source identifiers.
records.sourceNote: The institutional dataset page links summary releases and the openly deposited dose-level data.

records.name: Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer
records.subtitle: GDSC · Single-drug cell-line response
records.accessDetail: GDSC2 response tables and raw screening data are downloadable through Cell Model Passports. Review the data-use terms for your intended reuse.
records.summary: Cancer cell-line drug sensitivity with molecular characterisation.
records.usefulFor: Connect single-agent sensitivity with molecular features before combination research.
records.caveat: This is primarily single-agent screening; it does not measure combination synergy.
records.sourceNote: Sanger lists GDSC2 IC50, AUC and raw data alongside molecular profiles.

records.name: PRISM Repurposing
records.subtitle: Pooled cancer cell-line viability screens
records.accessDetail: Broad provides primary and secondary screening tables, treatment metadata and processing notes as public downloads.
records.summary: Viability measurements for repurposing-library compounds screened across cancer cell lines.
records.usefulFor: Find single-agent activity and dose-response starting points for repurposing research.
records.caveat: Pooled in-vitro screens do not establish clinical efficacy or combination effects.
records.sourceNote: The Broad project page provides screen designs, response files and treatment/cell-line metadata.

records.name: Cancer Dependency Map
records.subtitle: DepMap · Molecular profiles and perturbation data
records.accessDetail: Public release files are available through the DepMap download portal; use the release-specific citation and file documentation.
records.summary: Cancer cell-line molecular profiles linked with genetic dependencies and drug-screen data.
records.usefulFor: Find molecular context and dependency measurements for candidate targets.
records.caveat: Some drug-screen files overlap PRISM and other catalogued resources; these are not independent validation cohorts.
records.sourceNote: Broad describes public CRISPR, PRISM, expression, mutation and copy-number releases.
